name: Kota Bharu
pointBasis: Immutable WUP 2025 City_Code 2212 coordinate, copied without adjustment; latitude/longitude order preserved.
registryBasis: The official Pejabat Tanah dan Jajahan Kota Bharu (PTJKB) site identifies the local land office, links public land-tax/status/form services, and names Kota Bharu's land-office address. The official PTG Kelantan site identifies the state land-and-mines office in Kota Bharu. This evidences local registry/land-administration custody, not an open parcel geometry service or title conclusion.
blocker: No anonymous first-party Kota Bharu/Kelantan parcel geometry response with a safe stable parcel identifier was verified. The only public ArcGIS cadastral service inspected is hosted by MBSP and its metadata identifies Pulau Pinang/Seberang Perai Cassini CRS and extent, not Kota Bharu. This is not evidence of citywide parcel absence.

source.name: Pejabat Tanah dan Jajahan Kota Bharu / Pejabat Pengarah Tanah dan Galian Negeri Kelantan; JUPEM-attributed public cadastral reference inspected via MBSP ArcGIS host
source.operator: Pejabat Tanah dan Jajahan Kota Bharu (local land office), Pejabat Pengarah Tanah dan Galian Negeri Kelantan (state land office), and JUPEM for national cadastral survey/mapping functions; public GIS host inspected was Majlis Bandaraya Seberang Perai (MBSP).
source.serviceType: Official local land-registry/procedure evidence; no verified public Kota Bharu parcel feature service
source.operatorNote: Only safe public metadata and administrative context retained. No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, personal, or credential fields requested or retained.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official PTJKB, PTG Kelantan, JUPEM public information, and one anonymous ArcGIS cadastral service metadata/query route were reviewed.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Local land-office custody and public land-administration entry points are evidenced; an anonymous Kota Bharu parcel geometry response and safe parcel ID remain unverified. The immutable WUP point was preserved and not shifted.

technicalBlocker: PTJKB's public site exposes links to services including eKadaster, land-tax payment/status, and GeoForm, but the reviewed HTML did not expose a public parcel API. The ArcGIS service that returned cadastral layer metadata is limited by its stated Pulau Pinang/Seberang Perai CRS and extent; the point query timed out and was not treated as an absence result.
remainingUncertainty: Whether PTJKB/PTG Kelantan or JUPEM provides a separate public Kota Bharu/Kelantan parcel viewer/API, and whether it permits anonymous safe-ID geometry queries, remains unknown. JUPEM's public site route for cadastral information also returned a TLS certificate verification failure from this environment; no certificate exception was used.

Official Kelantan land-revenue portal reachable. It was treated as a procedure/service entry point only; no owner, title, account, or personal lookup was attempted.
Metadata confirms polygon layers Lot Sementara, Lot Kadaster 2018, and Lot Kadaster 2009, safe query formats, and a Cassini CRS explicitly named Pulau Pinang/Seberang Perai. Not Kota Bharu coverage.

Layer schema confirms polygon geometry and safe fields OBJECTID, LOT, MUKIM, DAERAH, ADUN, PARLIMEN, DAERAH_ID, MUKIM_ID, SEKSYEN_ID, and UPI. No response geometry retained because geographic scope is Penang/Seberang Perai.
